calls.statement:
SELECT COUNT(*) as web_orders
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) = '2025-12-01'
  AND order_ts_utc IS NOT NULL

SELECT 
  MIN(order_ts_utc) as earliest_order,
  MAX(order_ts_utc) as latest_order,
  COUNT(*) as order_count
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) = '2025-12-01'
